entities.summary: Anastasia Tsakiri is a Greek female weightlifter, competing in the 63 kg category and representing Greece at international competitions. She participated at the 2004 Summer Olympics in the 63 kg event. She competed at world championships, most recently at the 2002 World Weightlifting Championships.
